fields.label: Action Type
fields.options:
Price Update
Reorder PO
Ad Spend
Listing Edit

fields.label: Action Type Code
fields.description: Short code derived from action_type for the autoname pattern (PRICE / REORDER / ADSPEND / LISTING). Set in the controller, not by hand.

fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Which connector this action targets, e.g. shopify / amazon_sp_api / nayaglobal. Left blank for actions that aren't channel-specific.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Draft
Needs Review
Approved
Rejected
Blocked
Executed
Execution Failed

fields.label: Margin Floor %
fields.description: The floor this proposal was checked against — 15-20% contribution margin after landed cost + channel fees, per policy. Stored per-row so a later policy change doesn't silently reinterpret an old proposal's history.

fields.label: Projected Margin %
fields.description: Computed from reconciled landed cost at proposal time — the "margin impact" a reviewer sees before approving.

fields.label: Capital Pool
fields.description: Set only for actions that consume pool capital (Reorder PO, Ad Spend). A Price Update or Listing Edit does not deploy capital on its own, so this is left blank for those.

fields.label: Amount Requested
fields.description: How much of capital_pool this action would deploy if approved.

fields.label: Reconciliation OK
fields.description: False means the cross-system state this proposal depends on was stale, missing, or inconsistent when generated. A proposal with this unchecked must not be approved — see block_reason.

fields.label: Block Reason
fields.description: Why reconciliation failed, in plain language, e.g. "Nayaglobal capacity data is 6 hours stale" or "Unicommerce stock and Amazon-reported stock disagree by 40 units".

fields.label: Reconciliation Snapshot (JSON)
fields.description: The exact cross-system state read at proposal time, so a reviewer (or a later audit) can see precisely what this decision was based on, not just its conclusion.
